sentences.text: I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection.
I have also perused the Case Diary.
4. The FIR is lodged by Sri Nipan Roy, A Junior Assistant against the petitioner.
The petitioner is the Additional District Programme Manager (ADPM) of Dhubri Zila Parishad.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the allegations have been made by Junior Assistant pertaining two years of misappropriation of funds for personal gain without information of the informant, who is the Junior Assistant.
The office furnitures have been taken away allegedly by the petitioner for his personal use.
There is an allegation of the using petrol for the official vehicle despite objections by the informant.
On the contrary, it is submitted that the CEO has lodged a complaint against Nipan Roy, who has suggested for his suspension due to the anomalies committed by him.
An FIR was also lodged against the informant.
The copies of the letter of the CEO as well as the FIR lodged by the CEO against the informant, will form a part of the record.
It is submitted that no case under Sections 420/406/409/468/471 IPC can be made out from the contents of the FIR.

5. The petitioner has appeared before the IO and his statement has been recorded.
6. In view of my foregoing discussions and considering all aspects, the order dated 21.03.2023 is hereby made absolute.
Send back the Case Diary.
